answer: Every identity keeps a live beacon: a signed heartbeat emitted only from a delay-vault opened by that identity's own prior-epoch receipts, never by a fresh inbound transfer. A public atlas plots each beacon against its funding clique and the signer's attestation fingerprint. Beacons that collapse onto the same fingerprint or funding clique share one claim; surplus copies are dropped and their locked stake is burned. Epoch nectar streams only to those unique beacons, so a factory minting a thousand keys still draws one share unless it also provisions distinct vaults and funding trails.
